SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalLogs, SUM(CASE WHEN execution_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS runningCount, SUM(CASE WHEN execution_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCount, SUM(CASE WHEN execution_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN execution_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS timeoutCount, SUM(CASE WHEN execution_status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelledCount, COALESCE(AVG(duration_ms), 0) AS avgDurationMs FROM task_execution_log
AND task_id = #{taskId}
